title: Toy Train
body:
"Choo Choo! Create your own custom train tracks and create the most popular train industry."

The Toy Train is a decorative object in Oaklands. It is a tiny steam train that runs on tracks. It was only purchasable during the 2023, 2024 and, 2025 Christmas event for $2,400 at The Oak Depot and 2400 Snowflakes in Santa's workshop respectively.

Details

Unboxing the Toy Train prompts the user with a placement system similar to running wires for Logic systems. Players can place rails anywhere they want on the property, though the rails will always face down towards the ground. There are no rules as to how large the rail system is, nor whether it intersects with itself or other props. All the player is required to do is to create a complete loop of rail.

Once completed, the Toy Train will run along the rails. It emits a chugging sound and occasionally plays a steam train horn sound.
